$comment: #779 — machine-readable cryptographic-core pins, enforced by scripts/check-crypto-pins.js. Packages in tier 'crypto-core' are never auto-patched by scripts/auto-patch-cve.js; a bump needs a human decision plus an update to this file in the same PR.

crypto-core.description: Barretenberg / Noir proving stack. A bump changes the proof ABI; requires manual review with the ABI checklist in docs/security-runbook.md.

pins.name: @aztec/bb.js
pins.rationale: Barretenberg (UltraHonk) backend validated by the ZK aggregation spike together with nargo/noir_js 1.0.0-beta.9.

pins.name: @noir-lang/noir_js
pins.rationale: Noir execution runtime; must match the Barretenberg backend and the sibling @noir-lang packages.

pins.name: @noir-lang/acvm_js
pins.rationale: ACVM WASM bindings used by noir_js; version-locked to noir_js.

pins.name: @noir-lang/noirc_abi
pins.rationale: Circuit ABI encoder used by noir_js; version-locked to noir_js.

pins.name: @noir-lang/types
pins.rationale: Shared Noir types used by noir_js and noirc_abi; version-locked to noir_js.

couplings.description: noir_js, acvm_js, noirc_abi and types ship from one Noir release and must resolve to the same version.

cargoCrates.description: If a Barretenberg crate is ever added to Cargo.lock it must be the same release as the bb.js WASM backend.
